title: Arboreal Objects and Their Homotopy Theory
summary: We construct a category $\OrdFor$ as an arboreal extension of $Δ_{\mathrm{epi}}\subseteqΔ$, whose morphisms are ordered forests composed by grafting. We define a full functor $π\colon \OrdFor\toΔ_{\mathrm{epi}}^{op}$ extracting the semisimplicial shadow. For every complete category $\mathcal C$, this induces a fully faithful functor from semisimplicial objects in $\mathcal C$ to $\mathcal C$-valued presheaves on $\OrdFor$, with right adjoint given by right Kan extension.
